response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, including C++ (though primarily in embedded systems and not recent capital markets), his recent roles focus heavily on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages/stacks, with no clear evidence of SQL Server/Oracle expertise or fixed-income domain knowledge. His resume lacks recent hands-on C++ work on Windows, a key mandatory requirement for this role.
strengths: Strong general software engineering experience with a focus on testable, maintainable code
Proven ability to learn and work with diverse technologies and languages
Experience with large-scale systems and performance optimization
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ development on Windows (mandatory skill)
No demonstrated fixed-income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise

key_factors.factor: Fixed income / capital markets domain knowledge
